notes.title: Self-Checkout Unlimited Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/argentgames/self-checkout-unlimited-a-3d-mall-adventure][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/1325d78c45c8941a3ac065ecb2430fe30c93f087.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]We just launched the Kickstarter for our latest game, [u][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/argentgames/self-checkout-unlimited-a-3d-mall-adventured]Self-Checkout Unlimited! [/url][/b][/u][/h2]

[u][b][url=https://argent-games.itch.io/self-checkout-unlimited]Check out the demo,[/url][/b][/u] available on both Windows and Mac!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/949b14fd40943965a2409be579ceba3378ceaed9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/7485eb0a88a15812a07dfa222eaa95211bfc7488.png[/img]

An empty shopping mall after closing time.

Lost and alone inside a picture-perfect labyrinth.

As sunset slowly approaches, navigate between surreal stores to find the exit key, with only two cheerful PA announcers to keep you company. Can you unravel the mystery of your journey before it's time to say goodbye?

"Thank you for choosing Wilson Center Mall—a single stop for everything you'll ever need!"

❤

Inspired by the 8-circuit model of consciousness, the mallsoft genre, and the book Angel Tech by Antero Alli, Self-Checkout Unlimited is a unique exploration of both mind and matter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/bbd4e38e21adfa56be771ef7175844dfe9bc22c5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/cd767e7993b5b28d8a9df0472a79364ee7ef088b.png[/img]

Genre: Adventure, exploration, philosophical, surreal
Length: Short (~1-2 hrs, replayable)
Est. Release: Summer 2020

-Different story elements and endings based on your choices
-"Free Mall" mode—upon completion of the main game, explore the full mall freely without the story
-An original soundtrack inspired by nostalgic mall jazz and surreal dreamy synthscapes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/b43323f5ad9a1b6680ba3ccfc53f865225b71bd1.jpg[/img]

You can find SCU's Steam page below, along with more details about our surreal new 3D adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221320/SelfCheckout_Unlimited/

notes.title: Update 1.4: Big ending patch
notes.content:
In the continuing bug saga, we've just vanquished the [u][b]Andrei-Heath unintentional death ending[/b][/u], as well as fixed many other ending problems (supporting x, being saved by y, etc). 

This bug was newly introduced due to an earlier alteration we made; by making other endings easier to get, we accidentally allowed them to override Andrei's, as the calculation wasn't tabulating everything properly.

We really, truly appreciate your patience! As a small 2-person dev team working on such a large game, we're very grateful for everyone's support and helpful feedback as we tackle these bugs.

This update is most likely the last big one we'll need to roll out as most other issues have been fixed. [b]However, we'll update with another hotfix today if necessary, and keep attacking all buggies until the game is bug-free![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.3: Even more bugfixes!
notes.content:
A quick update that's not quite as substantial as the previous one, but fixes some new buggies that the last patch may have introduced!

A big thanks to our players here and on our Discord server for sending in screenshots and error reports!

-Death endings should no longer be as prevalent
-Special endings should be more easily achieved
-Leader ending should work more smoothly/have correct epilogue text
-Heath's route should allow the player to reach an epilogue ending with him more easily
-Other small visual/text bugs

If you continue to run into more errors, please leave a comment, send us an email at [u]contact@argentgames.co[/u], or join the bughunting party on [url=https://discord.gg/dFjSBxc]our Discord server.[/url]

Thanks again!

notes.title: Update 1.1: Important bugfixes!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your awesome support during RE:H's release! 

As some of you have noticed, there were some significant late-game bugs that needed to be ironed out, so we jumped on them as quickly as we could! We've pushed a patch to both Steam and Itch.io.

[b]If you were previously having difficulty with a romance path or achieving a certain ending, you'll likely find it much easier to reach in this patch. [/b]

We've also fixed some smaller bugs in the CG gallery, certain characters' lineart, and other things players have helpfully pointed out.

We really appreciate your feedback so far, and we love seeing your reactions to RE:H!
